sections.title: Retrieval scope и установка runtime
sections.text:
Repository-only design: immutable OPUS supplied in audits/2026-09-29-stable-audit/opus, закрытые P1/P2 inputs, существующие implementation/tests. Web/MCP search не требовался: нет решения о новом внешнем dependency behavior, version recommendation или новом vendor protocol; PSR signature берётся из нормативного API и локальных dependencies. No-search record, не утверждение внешней проверки.
Read-only plan.py show/check: P0/P1/P2 finished, P3 skeleton, baseline structural check 0 errors/0 warnings. Installed provider skill cache task/0.28.4 носит старую Markdown projection. Actual configured source /home/vostrikov/projects/packages/swissknifeman/packages/task/scripts/plan.py умеет canonical JSON layout v4; D25 явно требует этот native facade. Отказ legacy plan-work design-context: plan.md missing; canonical не мигрировать обратно, служебную среду не менять.
Ни один product test не исполнялся в design. Предписанные будущие файлы tests/PublicApi, Operations, Tenancy, Content и tests/Uploads/P3 создаются item owner; reads на существующие baseline файлы отделены от future deliverable paths. SHA-256 ниже нужен reviewer для оценки design inputs; изменение input требует impact уточнения, не объявляется product failure.

sections.title: Normative coverage
sections.text: P3 ledger создаётся по существующим section owners и неизменным opus-units.tsv; units IDs и source manifest сохраняются. Общие секции glossary/globals служат reference, не требуют реализации features другой фазы. Конкретные mixed verification rows назначаются item по V04/V05/V08/V16/V27/V29/V30/V31; остальные Vxx сохраняют исходного владельца. Каждая P3 literal carrier генерируется literal_sections(), включая source_text с исходными переносами; никакой ручной редакции OPUS. Atomic activation нормы P3.2 связана с P3.3 в обоих inputs. D06 self-check в phase sections перечисляет owned requirements, named files/signatures/algorithms, acceptance и preserved phase seams.

sections.title: Actual context rendering and optional brief limitation
sections.text:
Все восемь supported plan.py context <plan> P3.m --stdout успешно построились в временные файлы вне плана; mandatory reads существуют, статусы todo и result=null. Raw packs около 5.9MB каждый из-за унаследованного global knowledge: их нельзя печатать в основной context, D25 требует хранить файлом и читать targeted документы/fields. New P3 documents scoped applies_to=P3; historical global documents не переписывались.
Optional plan.py brief P3.1 --out диагностирован BRIEF_INCOMPLETE /decisions/1/decision: lifecycle phrase task:plan-run: native exec/v1 projection отвергает исторический принятый D03 текст. Это конкретная текущая несовместимость альтернативного delegate-input projection, не product failure и не missing P3 read. D03/Task runtime не переписывались в design; обычный owner executor использует поддерживаемый context API. В P3 units/delegation не объявлены, поэтому brief не обязательный execution path. Если позже потребуется delegation через exec/v1, owning runtime должен исправить projection; нельзя выпускать фиктивный успешный brief.

sections.title: Repository evidence for F01–F11 repair
sections.text:
Read-only facts: 7 canCreateInWorkspace вызовов в 6 production files (NodeResource имеет 2); scripts/php84 заканчивается exec "$@", значит V6 нужен php перед -d; PurgeTrashCommand materialized loop не имел per-root catch, physical purgeSubtree обеспечивает FK cascade; documents PurgeTrashCascadeTest skips вне PG. OPUS 09 §6 not_required allowed и OPUS 02/D18 non-clean blocked различаются; это именно OPUS D18, PLAN2.D18 миграционный и неизменен. P4.7 detailed item не существует: только planned-item текст P4 skeleton изменён. P3.3 route изменён на frontier/high; остальные route/review сохранены.
Изменения contract-полей F01–F11 см. @plan/knowledge/P3-review-packet.json#Design-Repair-2026-10-06. D26/D27/D28 open, ожидает принятия владельцем. Все 23 baseline source SHA из Sources пересверяются, не обновляются под design edits. Product PHP/Pest/DB/CI не запускались, F09 остаётся PLAUSIBLE относительно runtime. context7 инструмент недоступен в этой сессии; поддержку Pest flags не утверждаем, --fail-on-skipped/--fail-on-empty-test-suite не добавляем, выбираем разрешённый receipt-only вариант. Re-audit не запущен; GREEN отсутствует.
Static repair verification: 58 validation cmd invocations of scripts/php84 inspected via shlex in phase and all P3 items; 0 invalid first-option invocations, V6 executable is php. No product command executed. 23 original Sources SHA verified, drift0. Incoming source IDs P0→P3 25, P1→P3 22, P2→P3 61: every ID exists in ledger-P3; byte-identical ledger and 8 literal carriers preserved. This verifies source presence/provenance; historical item remappings were not re-audited. Product/OPUS/closed phase bytes unchanged. Purge/empty signatures rechecked against OPUS05: purge():void; empty():int returns successfully purged ROOT count on a no-error pass, after unexpected failures it reports all and rethrows first error only after remaining roots.

sections.title: Принятые corrections текущего и remaining плана
sections.text:
Owner-authorized plan corrections after cloud/OSS research and targeted implementation inspection. Native authoring accepted D26C/D27A/D28A and new D29 by agent delegation; root execution rule + C01–C10 mandatory correction contract + all P3 items and P4–P8 skeletons consume it. NEW P5.3 declared, detailed only during P5 design. Actual code gaps C05 staging swallowing, C06 premature relay settlement, C03 nested upload cleanup/stream exception assigned future owners. P1 scoped CAS/quota and existing pending/failed delivery lease recovery retained. No whole-code certification.

Historical research adoption stage: supplemental design was required; current completed specification is in Supplemental-Design-2026-10-06 and P3-security-contracts. Accepted policy branches unchanged. plan.design lifecycle remains detailed; root/phase Next prevents mistaking prior ready state for authorization to skip changed-input design. No P3 todo/result changed; no product tests/DB/CI, commits/push, or fresh audit. Original audit RED remains historical/stale; no GREEN inference. Closed P0/P1/P2, immutable OPUS and coverage ledgers unchanged.

Input closure now includes root plan, P3 phase/eight items/dossier/invariants/examples/review-packet/evidence, D26–D29, future skeleton P4–P8, mandatory correction contract, targeted implementation assessment, research results plus research prompt/raw provenance. Handoff is output excluded from fingerprint, validation excluded to avoid self-reference; generated views/log excluded. Raw OPUS/P3 literal manifest remains sourced as before. Actual implementation SHA subset in assessment plus 23 original baseline SHA in evidence/Sources; source changes require requalification.

sections.title: Concrete repository supplemental design evidence
sections.text:
Owner-requested design only. Read first P3-security-research-handoff, then correction/assessment/research, accepted D26–D29, all item contracts and current repository seams/tests. No extra external vendor behavior recommendation introduced; uses already researched primary-source capture and actual installed code, not raw prompt priority. Product/static facts: existing drive/public-share controllers stream via StorageDriver::get and do not redirect; no production temporaryUrl caller found; built-in preview/thumbnail handlers are descriptors, no installed derivative cache or conditional304 branch; NodeExportService reads inline DocumentContent; actual PersistCollaborationStateAction mutates Yjs head in BOTH debounce and append branches; CompleteUploadAction sniff outside first stream finally and discard after nested-return. These are static facts, not runtime fault reproduction.
P3-security-contracts supplies concrete schemas/interfaces, policy activation/admission/backfill, state/recovery/cleanup, scope/operation/egress/writer maps and SEC/D06 checks. Item reads/task_files/validation/deliverables are refined without replacing historical coverage assignments. Files absent at design baseline are future owning deliverables, never mandatory existing-source reads. Canonical plan.py apply/add-document used; no Markdown view edits, no old plan-work or runtime/environment patches. No product PHP/Pest/DB/CI/negative controls/independent audit, no commits/push.
